body.en:
Why Fractional Exponents & Polynomial Remainder Theorem Work: By the power-of-a-power law \((a^m)^n = a^{mn}\), raising \(x^{m/n}\) to the \(n\)-th power yields \((x^{m/n})^n = x^m\). Taking the \(n\)-th root of both sides establishes the fundamental radical-exponent identity:

\[ x^{m/n} = \sqrt[n]{x^m} = \left(\sqrt[n]{x}\right)^m \]

For any polynomial \(P(x)\) divided by a linear factor \((x - c)\), the division algorithm states \(P(x) = (x - c)Q(x) + R\). Substituting \(x = c\) annihilates the quotient term \((c - c)Q(c) = 0\), proving that the remainder is \(R = P(c)\) — and \((x - c)\) is a factor of \(P(x)\) if and only if \(P(c) = 0\).
body.ar:
Why Fractional Exponents & كثيرة الحدود Remainder مبرهنة Work: By the power-of-a-power law \((a^m)^n = a^{mn}\), raising \(x^{m/n}\) to the \(n\)-th power yields \((x^{m/n})^n = x^m\). Taking the \(n\)-th root of both sides establishes the fundamental radical-exponent المتطابقة:

\[ x^{m/n} = \sqrt[n]{x^m} = \left(\sqrt[n]{x}\right)^m \]

For any كثيرة الحدود \(P(x)\) divided by a linear factor \((x - c)\), the division algorithm states \(P(x) = (x - c)Q(x) + R\). Substituting \(x = c\) annihilates the quotient term \((c - c)Q(c) = 0\), proving that the remainder is \(R = P(c)\) — and \((x - c)\) is a factor of \(P(x)\) if and only if \(P(c) = 0\).

question.en:
Level 1 · Foundations

Which expression is equivalent to \( \frac{x^{5/3}}{x^{2/3}} \cdot \sqrt{x} \) for all positive values of \( x \)?
question.ar:
حل المسألة التالية في (Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions): Level 1 · Foundations

Which expression is equivalent to \( \frac{x^{5/3}}{x^{2/3}} \cdot \sqrt{x} \) for all positive values of \( x \)?

solution.en:
Step 1: Subtract powers for the quotient: \[ \frac{x^{5/3}}{x^{2/3}} = x^{5/3 - 2/3} = x^{3/3} = x^1. \]

Step 2: Multiply by \( \sqrt{x} = x^{1/2} \): \[ x^1 \cdot x^{1/2} = x^{1 + 1/2} = x^{3/2} = \sqrt{x^3}. \]
solution.ar:
خطوات الحل التفصيلية:

Step 1: Subtract powers for the quotient: \[ \frac{x^{5/3}}{x^{2/3}} = x^{5/3 - 2/3} = x^{3/3} = x^1. \]

Step 2: Multiply by \( \sqrt{x} = x^{1/2} \): \[ x^1 \cdot x^{1/2} = x^{1 + 1/2} = x^{3/2} = \sqrt{x^3}. \]

hints.en: Subtract powers for the quotient: \(\frac{x^{5/3}}{x^{2/3}} = x^{5/3 - 2/3} = x^{3/3} = x^1\).
hints.ar: تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(\frac{x^{5/3}}{x^{2/3}} = x^{5/3 - 2/3} = x^{3/3} = x^1\) لتبسيط الخطوة.

hints.en: Multiply by \( \sqrt{x} = x^{1/2} \): \(x^1 \cdot x^{1/2} = x^{1 + 1/2}\). Substitute and simplify: \(x^1 \cdot x^{1/2} = x^{3/2}\).
hints.ar: Multiply by \( \sqrt{x} = x^{1/2} \): \(x^1 \cdot x^{1/2} = x^{1 + 1/2}\). عوّض بالقيم وبسّط العبارة: \(x^1 \cdot x^{1/2} = x^{3/2}\).

label.en: ● The 4 Essential Forms of an Exponential Function — Interpretation & Instant Graphing Guide
label.ar: ● The 4 Essential Forms of an Exponential الدالة — Interpretation & Instant Graphing Guide

body.en:
On the Digital SAT, exponential functions appear in four recurring algebraic forms. Each form encodes how the initial value, multiplier, time interval, or vertical shift is presented:

Exponential FormWhat Constants Reveal DirectlyHorizontal BaselineAnchor Point(s)\(y\)-InterceptHow to Quickly Graph (Step-by-Step)
1. Standard Base–Multiplier Form
\(f(x) = a \cdot b^x\)		Initial value \(a\) at \(x = 0\) and multiplier \(b\) per \(+1\) unit of \(x\) (\(b > 1\) growth, \(0 < b < 1\) decay).\(y = 0\)\((0, a)\) and \((1, ab)\)\((0, a)\)Draw baseline \(y = 0\); plot \((0, a)\), \((1, ab)\), and \((-1, a/b)\); sketch the smooth curve approaching \(y = 0\).
2. Percentage Rate Form
\(f(t) = a(1 \pm r)^t\)		Initial value \(a\) and percentage change rate \(r\) per unit time (\(+r\) = \(\%\) increase, \(-r\) = \(\%\) decrease; base \(b = 1 \pm r\)).\(y = 0\)\((0, a)\) and \((1, a(1 \pm r))\)\((0, a)\)Convert rate \(r\) to base \(b = 1 \pm r\); plot \((0, a)\) and step \(+1\) unit right to \((1, a(1 \pm r))\).
3. Period-Scaled (Interval) Form
\(f(t) = a \cdot b^{t / k}\)		Quantity starts at \(a\) and multiplies by factor \(b\) every \(k\) units of time (e.g., doubling time or half-life \(k\)).\(y = 0\)\((0, a)\), \((k, ab)\), \((2k, ab^2)\)\((0, a)\)Plot \((0, a)\), then step horizontally by \(k\) units (not \(1\) unit!) to plot \((k, ab)\) and \((2k, ab^2)\)!
4. Vertically Shifted Form
\(f(x) = a \cdot b^{x - h} + d\)		Horizontal baseline \(y = d\) and shifted anchor point \((h, a + d)\) where the exponent \(x - h = 0\).\(y = d\)\((h, a + d)\) and \((h + 1, ab + d)\)\((0, a b^{-h} + d)\)1. Draw dashed horizontal line \(y = d\); 2. Plot \((h, a+d)\) (since \(b^0 = 1\)); 3. Step \(+1\) right to \((h+1, ab+d)\)!

Algebraic Equivalence Between Forms (Frequent SAT Question Type): Using exponent laws \(b^{t/k} = (b^{1/k})^t\) and \(a \cdot b^{x - h} = (a b^{-h}) \cdot b^x\), any Period-Scaled or Shifted form can be rewritten in Standard Form \(A \cdot B^x\) by setting \(A = a b^{-h}\) and \(B = b^{1/k}\).

label.en: ⚠️ SAT Traps & Pitfalls — Exponentials, Polynomials & Radicals
label.ar: ⚠️ SAT Traps & Pitfalls — Exponentials, Polynomials & Radicals (الأسس والجذور وكثيرات الحدود والعبارات النسبية)

body.en:
• Growth Rate vs. Growth Factor: 'Increases by \( 12\% \) each year' means the base is \( b = 1 + 0.12 = 1.12 \), NOT \( 0.12 \). Similarly, 'decreases by \( 12\% \)' means \( b = 1 - 0.12 = 0.88 \).
  • Time Interval Exponent Scaling: If a population doubles every \( 4 \) hours, the exponent is \( t/4 \), yielding \( P(t) = P_0(2)^{t/4} \). Writing \( 2^{4t} \) means it doubles \( 4 \) times per hour (16-fold increase per hour)!
  • Extraneous Roots from Squaring: Squaring both sides of a radical equation can introduce false solutions (e.g. \( (-3)^2 = 3^2 \)). Always check prospective roots in the original radical equation.
  • Fractional Exponent Rule: \( x^{a/b} = \sqrt[b]{x^a} = (\sqrt[b]{x})^a \). The denominator is always the root index, and the numerator is the power.
body.ar:
• Growth Rate vs. Growth Factor: 'Increases by \( 12\% \) each year' means the base is \( b = 1 + 0.12 = 1.12 \), NOT \( 0.12 \). Similarly, 'decreases by \( 12\% \)' means \( b = 1 - 0.12 = 0.88 \).
  • Time Interval Exponent Scaling: If a population doubles every \( 4 \) hours, the exponent is \( t/4 \), yielding \( P(t) = P_0(2)^{t/4} \). Writing \( 2^{4t} \) means it doubles \( 4 \) times per hour (16-fold increase per hour)!
  • Extraneous Roots from Squaring: Squaring both sides of a radical المعادلة can introduce false الحلول (e.g. \( (-3)^2 = 3^2 \)). Always check prospective roots in the original radical المعادلة.
  • Fractional Exponent Rule: \( x^{a/b} = \sqrt[b]{x^a} = (\sqrt[b]{x})^a \). The denominator is always the root index, and the numerator is the power.

label.ar: Level 2 (Medium) — مثال محلول

body.en:
Problem: A computer depreciates in value by 18% each year. If its initial purchase price was \$2,500, write a function modeling its value \( V(t) \) after \( t \) years.

Solution: The initial value is \( a = 1500 \). An 18% decrease means the annual decay factor is \( b = 1 - 0.18 = 0.82 \). The model is: \[ V(t) = 1500(0.82)^t. \]
body.ar:
Problem: A computer depreciates in value by 18% each year. If its initial purchase price was \$2,500, write a الدالة modeling its value \( V(t) \) after \( t \) years.

Solution: The initial value is \( a = 1500 \). An 18% decrease means the annual decay factor is \( b = 1 - 0.18 = 0.82 \). The model is: \[ V(t) = 1500(0.82)^t. \]

question.ar:
Level 2 · Medium

A sample of a radioactive substance decays such that its mass is halved every 15 days. إذا كان the initial mass is 480 grams, which function models the mass \( M(t) \), in grams, remaining after \( t \) days?

solution.en:
The initial mass is \( a = 480 \). Halving corresponds to a decay factor of \( b = \frac{1}{2} \). Since halving occurs every 15 days, the exponent must count how many 15-day intervals have elapsed, which is \( \frac{t}{15} \):

\[ M(t) = 480\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{\frac{t}{15}}. \]
solution.ar:
The initial mass is \( a = 480 \). Halving corresponds to a decay حلّل of \( b = \frac{1}{2} \). Since halving occurs every 15 days, the exponent must count how many 15-day intervals have elapsed, which is \( \frac{t}{15} \):

\[ M(t) = 480\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{\frac{t}{15}}. \]

hints.ar: تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \( a = 480 \) لتبسيط الخطوة.

hints.en: Halving corresponds to a decay factor of \( b = \frac{1}{2} \).

blocks.heading: Level 3 · Advanced — Radical & Rational Equations with Extraneous Roots

body.en: Solve equations involving square roots and rational algebraic fractions, checking domain constraints and identifying extraneous solutions.
body.ar: Solve المعادلات involving square roots and rational algebraic fractions, checking المجال constraints and identifying extraneous الحلول.

label.ar: ▲ Rational المعادلات

body.en: Multiply through by the LCD to clear fractions. Identify domain restrictions (values making any denominator zero) before solving. Discard any solution that equals a restricted value.
body.ar: Multiply through by the LCD to clear fractions. Identify domain restrictions (values making any denominator zero) before solving. Discard any الحل that equals a restricted value.

label.ar: Level 3 (Advanced) — مثال محلول

body.en:
Solve for \( x \): \[ \frac{3}{x - 1} + \frac{1}{x + 1} = \frac{4}{x^2 - 1}. \]

Note restrictions: \( x \neq \pm 1 \). Multiply both sides by LCD \( (x - 1)(x + 1) \):

\[ 3(x + 1) + (x - 1) = 4 \implies 4x + 2 = 4 \implies 4x = 2 \implies x = \frac{1}{2}. \]

Check restriction: \( x = 1/2 \neq \pm 1 \), so the solution is valid.

question.en:
Level 3 · Advanced

What is the set of all real solutions to the radical equation \( \sqrt{2x - 5} = x - 4 \)?
question.ar:
حل المسألة التالية في (Exponentials, Radicals, Polynomials & Rational Expressions): Level 3 · Advanced

What is the set of all real solutions to the radical equation \( \sqrt{2x - 5} = x - 4 \)?

solution.en:
Square both sides:

\[ 2x - 5 = (x - 4)^2 = x^2 - 8x + 16 \implies x^2 - 10x + 21 = 0 \implies (x - 3)(x - 7) = 0. \]

Check prospective roots in original equation:

  • For \( x = 3 \): \( \sqrt{2(3) - 5} = \sqrt{1} = 1 \), but right side is \( 3 - 4 = -1 \). Since \( 1 eq -1 \), \( x = 3 \) is extraneous.
  • For \( x = 7 \): \( \sqrt{2(7) - 5} = \sqrt{9} = 3 \), and right side is \( 7 - 4 = 3 \). Valid!

The only real solution is \( x = 7 \).
solution.ar:

\[ 2x - 5 = (x - 4)^2 = x^2 - 8x + 16 \implies x^2 - 10x + 21 = 0 \implies (x - 3)(x - 7) = 0. \]

Check prospective roots in original equation:

  • For \( x = 3 \): \( \sqrt{2(3) - 5} = \sqrt{1} = 1 \), but right side is \( 3 - 4 = -1 \). Since \( 1 eq -1 \), \( x = 3 \) is extraneous.
  • For \( x = 7 \): \( \sqrt{2(7) - 5} = \sqrt{9} = 3 \), and right side is \( 7 - 4 = 3 \). Valid!

The only real solution is \( x = 7 \).

label.en: Level 4 (Synthesis) — Extraneous Solutions in Radical Equations
label.ar: Level 4 (Synthesis) — Extraneous الحلول in Radical المعادلات

body.en:
Problem: Solve \( \sqrt{2x + 15} = x + 3 \). How many real solutions exist?

Solution: Square both sides: \( 2x + 15 = (x + 3)^2 = x^2 + 6x + 9 \implies x^2 + 4x - 6 = 0 \). Wait—if the equation is \( \sqrt{2x + 3} = x \), squaring gives \( x^2 - 2x - 3 = 0 \implies (x-3)(x+1) = 0 \). Testing \( x = -1 \) in \( \sqrt{2(-1)+3} = -1 \) gives \( 1 = -1 \) (false, extraneous because the principal square root is always \( \ge 0 \)). Thus only \( x = 3 \) is valid!
body.ar:
Problem: Solve \( \sqrt{2x + 15} = x + 3 \). How many real الحلول exist?

Solution: Square both sides: \( 2x + 15 = (x + 3)^2 = x^2 + 6x + 9 \implies x^2 + 4x - 6 = 0 \). Wait—if the المعادلة is \( \sqrt{2x + 3} = x \), squaring gives \( x^2 - 2x - 3 = 0 \implies (x-3)(x+1) = 0 \). Testing \( x = -1 \) in \( \sqrt{2(-1)+3} = -1 \) gives \( 1 = -1 \) (false, extraneous because the principal square root is always \( \ge 0 \)). وعليه only \( x = 3 \) is valid!

question.en:
Level 4 · Synthesis

A radioactive isotope decays by 20% every 15 years. If the initial mass is 500 grams, which expression represents the remaining mass, in grams, after \( m \) months?
question.ar:
Level 4 · Synthesis

A radioactive isotope decays by 20% every 15 years. إذا كان the initial mass is 500 grams, which expression represents the remaining mass, in grams, after \( m \) months?

solution.en:
First convert 15 years into months: \( 15 \times 12 = 180 \) months per decay period.

Since the mass decreases by 20% each period, the retention factor is \( 1 - 0.20 = 0.80 \). After \( m \) months, the number of 180-month periods is \( \frac{m}{180} \):

\[ M(m) = 500(0.80)^{m/180}. \]
solution.ar:
First convert 15 years into months: \( 15 \times 12 = 180 \) months per decay period.

Since the mass decreases by 20% each period, the retention حلّل is \( 1 - 0.20 = 0.80 \). After \( m \) months, the number of 180-month periods is \( \frac{m}{180} \):

\[ M(m) = 500(0.80)^{m/180}. \]

تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(2x^2 + 3x - 1 - x^2 + 2x - 4\) لتبسيط الخطوة.

hints.en: Evaluate \((2x^2 - x^2) + (3x + 2x) + (-1 - 4)\) to obtain the final answer.
hints.ar: احسب قيمة \((2x^2 - x^2) + (3x + 2x) + (-1 - 4)\) to obtain the final answer.

solution.en: Distribute the negative sign: \( 2x^2 + 3x - 1 - x^2 + 2x - 4 = (2x^2 - x^2) + (3x + 2x) + (-1 - 4) = x^2 + 5x - 5 \).
solution.ar: خطوات الحل التفصيلية: Distribute the negative sign: \( 2x^2 + 3x - 1 - x^2 + 2x - 4 = (2x^2 - x^2) + (3x + 2x) + (-1 - 4) = x^2 + 5x - 5 \).

label.en: ● Master Atlas of the 9 Main Parent Functions & Universal Transformation Law
label.ar: ● الأطلس الشامل للدوال الأم التسع وقانون التحويلات الهندسية العام

body.en:
Every algebraic and elementary transcendental model is built by transforming one of the nine core parent functions via \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\), where \(|a|\) scales vertically (reflecting across the \(x\)-axis if \(a < 0\)), \(h\) shifts horizontally, and \(k\) shifts vertically:

FamilyTransformed Form \(g(x)\)DomainRange (\(a > 0\))Key Geometric Feature
Constant\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)Horizontal line, slope \(0\)
Linear\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Constant slope \(m = a\), pivot \((h, k)\)
Quadratic\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Parabola vertex \((h, k)\), axis \(x = h\)
Cubic\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Inflection center \((h, k)\), S-curve
Absolute Value\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)V-corner vertex \((h, k)\), slopes \(\pm a\)
Radical\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Endpoint \((h, k)\), half-parabola
Rational\(\dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\)\(x \neq h\)\(y \neq k\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), horizontal \(y = k\)
Exponential\(a \cdot 2^{x - h} + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((k, \infty)\)Horizontal asymptote \(y = k\), anchor \((h, a+k)\)
Logarithmic\(a\ln(x - h) + k\)\((h, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), anchor \((h+1, k)\)
body.ar:
تُبنى النماذج الجبرية والمتسامية الأساسية من خلال تطبيق التحويل القياسي \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\) على إحدى الدوال الأم التسع، حيث يتحكم \(|a|\) في التمدد الرأسي (مع انعكاس حول محور السينات إذا كان \(a < 0\))، ويمثل \(h\) الإزاحة الأفقية، و\(k\) الإزاحة الرأسية:

عائلة الدالةالصورة المحوّلة \(g(x)\)المجالالمدى (\(a > 0\))السمة الهندسية المميزة
الثابتة\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)مستقيم أفقي ميله \(0\)
الخطية\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)ميل ثابت \(m = a\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h, k)\)
التربيعية\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)قطع مكافئ رأسه \((h, k)\) ومحوره \(x = h\)
التكعيبية\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)نقطة انعطاف مركزية \((h, k)\)
القيمة المطلقة\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)رأس زاوي على شكل V عند \((h, k)\) بميلين \(\pm a\)
الجذرية\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)نقطة بداية \((h, k)\) ومجال مقيّد \(x \ge h\)
النسبية (المقلوب)\(\dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\)\(x \neq h\)\(y \neq k\)تقارب رأسي \(x = h\) وتقارب أفقي \(y = k\)
الأسية\(a \cdot 2^{x - h} + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((k, \infty)\)تقارب أفقي \(y = k\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h, a+k)\)
اللوغاريتمية\(a\ln(x - h) + k\)\((h, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)تقارب رأسي \(x = h\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h+1, k)\)
